{{Quote|That droid is as dumb as a Gamorrean. He'll buy anything 'cause he's too stupid to do anything else.|[[Panar]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
'''1B-8D-GE3''' was a [[GE3-series protocol droid]] owned by [[Tolas]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the years following the [[Jedi Civil War]] and used as an auxiliary when conducting sales of droid parts and other related equipment. When asked, 1B-8D provided [[Meetra Surik]] with the head of [[S-0D3-GE3]], which contained crucial evidence that proved the innocence of [[Dhagon Ghent]] in the murder of [[Sullio|Captain Sullio]], a member of the Onderon military.

==Behind the scenes==
If Surik has [[G0-T0]] in their party when she meets 1B-8D, she can have him reprogram 1B-8D to lower its prices and give free parts.
